"""Heavier differential fuzzing: larger universes, widths, predicate counts."""
import ctypes, json, random, sys, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
from brute import brute_batch
from gen import gen_batch
from netnomos.finite import compile_batch

def run(cases, seed0, mode):
    bad = 0
    total_time = 0.0
    for i in range(cases):
        rng = random.Random(seed0 + i)
        if mode == 'big':
            batch = gen_batch(rng, jobs=rng.randint(1, 2), big=True, width=rng.randint(2, 4),
                              max_pred=rng.randint(4, 9))
        elif mode == 'wide':
            batch = gen_batch(rng, jobs=1, width=4, max_pred=10)
        elif mode == 'tiny':
            batch = gen_batch(rng, jobs=rng.randint(1, 4), width=rng.randint(1, 4), max_pred=3, max_train=4)
        t = time.time()
        want = brute_batch(batch)
        got = compile_batch(batch)
        total_time += time.time() - t
        if got != want:
            bad += 1
            print('MISMATCH', mode, 'seed', seed0 + i)
            print(json.dumps(batch)[:4000])
            for a, b in zip(got['results'], want['results']):
                for key in ('rules', 'active', 'answers'):
                    if a[key] != b[key]:
                        print(' key', key)
                        print('  got ', json.dumps(a[key])[:2000])
                        print('  want', json.dumps(b[key])[:2000])
            if bad >= 1:
                break
    print('done', mode, cases, 'mismatches', bad, 'ours+ref time %.2fs' % total_time)
    return bad

if __name__ == '__main__':
    mode = sys.argv[1]; n = int(sys.argv[2]); seed = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 1000
    sys.exit(1 if run(n, seed, mode) else 0)
PYEOF
